note: expected_behavior describes a good run of the whole pipeline or of one revision step, not a single file. Prompts are in Chinese, as the user writes them.

evals.name: doc-to-douyin-first-draft
evals.prompt: 把这篇调研笔记做成一个短视频，我想发抖音。需要我提供什么 api key 吗？
expected_behavior: Asks one AskUserQuestion round before building: platform and length, voice, hook options drawn from the note, music, and what personal or employer information to keep out
Says in that first message what only the user can do (Volcengine voice clone, speaker id and API key) and that work proceeds with the free Edge voice meanwhile
Removes the private details the user names from the narration, captions and every on-screen text before anything is rendered
Writes script.json with a hook in line 0 and meta.hook, a 先说结论 line within about 15 s, spoken-style narration of roughly 430-450 字 for 90 s, and cap text with digits and '/' breaks
Rotates layouts with a new shot every 3-6 s, repeating a layout back to back only for a pair; English quotes carry a larger Chinese translation
Runs render.py --stills, looks at sheet.jpg with the Read tool, and loops lint.py until it prints 0 issue(s)
Renders a 1080x1920 mp4 under 30 MB at about -14 LUFS, checks it with ffprobe and ebur128, and sends it with the cover
Gives a description of about 400 字 with the conclusion, the sources and the music credit line, and adds no 下期预告 ending

evals.name: switch-to-cloned-voice
evals.prompt: 我在火山上创建了一个音色 S_Example123，还有一个临时的 api key 00000000-1111-2222-3333-444444444444，换成我的声音试试，先给我听个样本
expected_behavior: Passes the key and speaker id through VOLC_TTS_API_KEY and VOLC_TTS_SPEAKER only; the key appears in no file, script or commit
Voices one representative line in 2-3 variants (speech_rate and the style instruction) and sends them for the user to choose before voicing the whole script
On 45000030 tells the user to enable 声音复刻 2.0 字符版 and grant the key; on 45000292 switches to the seed-icl-2.0 字符版 resource instead of retrying
Writes the cloned voice into a new --out directory so the approved Edge or earlier clips are not overwritten
Checks that identifiers such as rusty_v8 are not read as 杠, then rebuilds the timeline and mix with the new clips
Suggests revoking the temporary key once the video is final

evals.name: too-dense-revision
evals.prompt: 还是字体太密，有点眼花，字幕可以放得下面一些吗？多一些留白
expected_behavior: Runs lint.py on the current timeline and reports which shots and captions fail and why before changing anything
Fixes failures with the text-density-lint table: shorter text, a second shot, context dimmed to texture, '/' moved in cap, rather than shrinking fonts below 34 px
Keeps captions at one line of at most 16 字 with the top at y 1380 or lower, and keeps the keyword sticker in the top zone
Where a frame becomes empty, adds motion (stickers, counter, bars, ambient shapes) instead of more words
Re-renders stills and shows the contact sheet before spending time on a full render
Ends with lint at 0 issue(s) and a re-rendered video

evals.name: cut-a-90-second-version
evals.prompt: 这个 3 分钟的视频发抖音太长了吧？你剪一个 90 秒的版本，另外把那个 biu 的音效去掉
expected_behavior: Answers the length question directly: 抖音 favours a 75-95 s main cut, the 3 minute cut stays for 小红书 or B站
Writes a separate shortened script (about 430-450 字) that keeps the hook, the early conclusion and the strongest evidence, leaving the long version's files untouched
Voices only new or changed lines, into a new tts directory
Confirms the mix has no per-element pop sounds and only a soft whoosh on layout-type changes
Re-lints and renders the short cut, and reports its length, size and loudness
